verdict.rationale: Working Copy connects directly via ssh/https/git/http protocols to any git server including self-hosted instances (GitHub Enterprise, GitLab, Gitea, AWS CodeCommit) with keys stored in Secure Enclave, requiring no proxy or cloud relay. A Hacker News user corroborates using Working Copy directly against a self-hosted AWS Lightsail git server, confirming real-world direct connectivity. Missing for 10: independent technical teardown of network traffic confirming no relay is used, and explicit VPN-avoidance documentation.
